The '''AR-101 Stun Cuffs''' was a model of [[Stuncuffs/Legends|stun cuffs]] produced by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]]. The cuffs were passive until a prisoner attempted to escape, upon which they delivered a stun charge to the wearer.
